for DAMAGING WINDS and LARGE HAILSTONES
The State Emergency Service advises that people should:
* Secure or put away loose items around your property.
* Move cars under cover or away from trees.
* Keep clear of fallen power lines.
* Stay indoors, away from windows, while storms are nearby.

warning-info.text: The next warning is due to be issued by 10:00 pm.

text.p: Check https://www.bom.gov.au/weather-and-climate/warnings-and-alerts. Warnings are also available through TV and Radio broadcasts or call 1300 659 210. The Bureau and State Emergency Service would appreciate warnings being broadcast regularly.

forecast-period.text: Severe thunderstorms are moving into the North West Pastoral this evening.

text.p: Weather Situation: A trough is expected to trigger severe thunderstorms about western South Australia this evening, after an active afternoon in southeastern Western Australia.

Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds and large hailstones in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include parts of the Great Victoria Desert.
